findings.detail: The stored maturity_date 2023-08-31 is the source Initial Acquisition Date; the investment text states the note is due 9/2029.

rationale: Class 1 maturity-date validation. The flagged value 2023-08-31 appears in the source row as the Initial Acquisition Date, while the same source row's investment description states 'due 9/2029'. Because report_date is 2023-09-30, the warning is caused by a real stored maturity-date extraction error rather than a genuinely matured position.
